title: Membership in the Prefix Language
statement: For natural numbers $C,c$, a language $V$ of bit strings, and a bit string $q$, membership of $q$ in the prefix language with length bound $C(\lvert\pi_1(q)\rvert+1)^c$ is equivalent to the existence of a bit string $s$ such that $\lvert d(\pi_2(q))s\rvert=C(\lvert\pi_1(q)\rvert+1)^c$ and the encoded pair $\langle\pi_1(q),d(\pi_2(q))s\rangle$ belongs to $V$. Here $\pi_1$ and $\pi_2$ are the total pair projections, defaulting to the empty string when parsing fails, and $d$ is the marker-dropping transduction.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a language of bit strings
